title: WIDESEEK-R1: Exploring Width Scaling for Broad Information Seeking via MARL

defines.name: WIDESEEK-R1
defines.definition: A lead-agent–subagent multi-agent system trained with multi-agent reinforcement learning to enable scalable orchestration and parallel execution for broad information seeking.

problem: Existing multi-agent systems for broad information seeking rely on hand-crafted workflows and serial turn-taking, which limits scalable orchestration, context isolation, and parallel execution.
